images.description: Troubleshooting Guide - Emails, Part 1: Troubleshooting the User Record shows an Edit User Record form with fields for Prefix, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, a Change Photo option, User Name, User ID, Local System ID, Original Hire Date, Last Hire Date, Allow Reconciliation and Absent.
images.alt: Cornerstone Learn troubleshooting guide showing the Edit User Record form

images.description: Troubleshooting Guide - Emails, Part 2: Troubleshooting the Email Template shows an Edit Email form with fields for Email Title, From Address, Reply-To Address, Type and recipient selection, plus an Action field, an Active setting and a default language option.
images.alt: Cornerstone Learn troubleshooting guide showing the Edit Email template form

images.description: Email - Create shows the Create New Email form with fields for Email Title, From Address, Reply-To Address, Type and recipient selection, a Change Default Language option, a default language setting, and an Action field.
images.alt: Cornerstone Learn Email Create form for a new email template

images.description: Email - Create, Notes Regarding Email Modification shows an Action selector with options Training is Due and Training is Due in One Week, fields for Email Title, From Address, Reply-To Address and Type, and a Reminder setting with minutes, hours and days options relative to an event.
images.alt: Cornerstone Learn notes on email modification with reminder timing options

images.description: Email - Create, Notes Regarding Email Modification shows an email form with an Email Title field set to Test, From Address and Reply-To Address fields, a Type field set to Confirmation, an Active setting, and a default language option set to English (US).
images.alt: Cornerstone Learn email create form with Test title and Confirmation type

images.description: Email Administration lists pre-defined email action triggers and includes Email Tips, a search area with a text field, a text field selector, an Email Action Type filter and an Email Category filter, an Expand/Collapse All control, an Include Inactive Emails option, and a table with Action, Action Type, Description and Options columns.
images.alt: Cornerstone Learn Email Administration page listing email action triggers
